entries.title: Threebot 0.1.15
entries.note: v0.1.15 · 10 changes from 3 contributors Notifications show the Bot. Push notifications now carry the Bot's own avatar and name, requests stay visible until you answer them, and you control push notifications. Your other chats can give permission. A request relayed from another of your chats or Bots now counts as yours, so Bots act on it without asking you again; switch it off in Settings → Permissions. Routines on their own model. A routine can run on a model of its choice, in its own conversation. Opens fast, even offline. Threebot installs its core right away and fetches the rest as you use it, and a Bot you've opened before opens from the device's copy when you're offline. Collapsible sidebar. A button collapses the sidebar, and the collapsed view is trimmed down to what you need. Clearer approval cards. Antigravity approval cards show the command you're being asked to approve. Libra

entries.title: Threebot 0.1.14
entries.note: v0.1.14 · 4 changes from 2 contributors One-click Windows installer. Each release now ships a Threebot-Setup installer for Windows, so you can install Threebot without running any scripts. Threebot in its own window on Windows. The Windows launcher opens Threebot in a dedicated app window that you can pin to the taskbar, and falls back to your browser if WebView2 isn't available. Lighter, steadier update checks. Update checks reuse GitHub's answer when nothing has changed and are spread out a little, so rate limits are hit less often, and Check now always fetches fresh results. Plus 1 more change. entries.title: Threebot 0.1.13
entries.note: v0.1.13 · 13 changes from 3 contributors Rooms follow delegated work. When a room member hands work to a subagent, the room keeps following it and shows what was delegated. Faster loads, smaller updates. The app is sent compressed, and updates download only the files that changed. Room history stays complete. Rooms always pick the newest reply, and a bad timestamp no longer hides earlier messages. Accurate usage on Windows. Usage stats now match Windows transcript paths, and your own threads in adopted repos aren't counted as Bot usage. Settled threads stay quiet. Threads that T3 Code has already settled no longer get settled again and again. Polish in chat and documents. Nested code fences render correctly, file cards don't show a stale size, spreadsheet cells take focus on click and copy out cleanly, and attachment previews no longer leak memory. Plus 2 more changes. Full changelog Wha

Full changelog What's Changed Open long chats about 4× faster and catch up right after the app comes back by @mertbozkir in #80 Release v0.1.12 by @RokaSwK in #81 Full Changelog : v0.1.11...v0.1.12

entries.title: Threebot 0.1.11
entries.note: v0.1.11 · 12 changes from 4 contributors Threebot on Windows. Run Threebot on Windows as a background service, from a self-installing portable bundle with its own launcher. Threebot on your phone. Scan a QR code in Settings to open your remote access link on your phone. Draw avatars from a phone. Drawing a custom Bot avatar now works on mobile, and you can pick the drawing model in Settings there too. Files in chat. Office documents get a preview, files open in a full-window viewer, and attachments show as file cards. Better Rooms. Attach files in a Room, start a Room conversation over, and enjoy a tidier composer. Settings › Usage. See your providers' limits and how many tokens each Bot uses. Memory that stays tidy. Bots can tidy their memory on a schedule, and Memory is reachable from the phone's Details sheet. Plus 2 more changes. Full changelog What's Changed fix: run the test suite

entries.title: Threebot 0.1.9
entries.note: v0.1.9 · 3 changes from 1 contributor Bots stay put. Bot conversations are no longer auto-settled by T3 after a quiet week, so they stay in your sidebar. Sign in from the secret card. When a Bot asks for a token, the card has a button that opens the page where you get it. Linked threads open at the end. Opening a linked thread jumps to its newest messages. Plus 1 more change. Full changelog What's Changed Keep Bot threads from being auto-settled by T3 after a quiet week by @RokaSwK in #63 Secret cards open the agent's sign-in page, and linked threads open at their newest messages by @RokaSwK in #64 Release v0.1.9 by @RokaSwK in #65 Full Changelog : v0.1.8...v0.1.9

entries.title: Threebot 0.1.7
entries.note: v0.1.7 · 11 changes from 3 contributors Rooms. Put several Bots in one room, talk to them together, and run panels or roundtables where they answer each other. See what's new. Updates now show their release notes in the app, with who made each change. Your other machines. See linked machines, open their threads in Threebot, and get told when one goes offline. Bots from existing projects. Turn a project you already have into a Bot without touching its git. Shape a Bot's role. Give a Bot its role when you create it, and edit its standing instructions later. Better composer. An @ mention menu, and lists that continue when you press Enter. PDFs, Mac app and dictation. View PDFs in chat, a steadier Mac app window and microphone, and OpenAI or Gemini dictation (beta). Plus 1 more change. Full changelog What's Changed Make a Bot from an existing project, without touching its git by @RokaSwK in
